result_text:
I fixed the six typo'd patterns in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The module's tests matching `*Scoping*` and `*Convention*` ran with no output, which `-q` gives for a pass. I didn't add a test for the new matches, so the fixes themselves are not tested.

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the extension group `(html|html|xhtml)` is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match as well as `.html` and `.xhtml`.
- **Generated JS and .NET docs:** `.*/[.]js` is now `.*[.]js` and `.*/[.]xml` is now `.*[.]xml`. The old patterns required a file literally named `.js` or `.xml`, so now `app.js` and `MyAssembly.xml` can match. The content patterns are unchanged, so ordinary hand-written `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of the generated scope.
- **Gradle JS:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` lands in build-and-deployment. The `build.gradle` rule is untouched.

I also saw `.*/[.](css|js)[.]map` in the generated-files list, which has the same kind of typo and never matches a real `.map` file. It wasn't one of the four you listed, so I left it alone.

I didn't commit anything.
